user.title: Create a thermostat
user.description: Choose a name and the hardware command strategy.

modes.title: Select HVAC modes
modes.description: Select at least one thermal mode. Dry mode is available only with discrete commands.

sensors.title: Select environment sensors
sensors.description: ThermoPilot averages every valid selected sensor. Humidity and pressure are optional.

hardware.title: Select hardware commands
hardware.description: Momentary switches are treated as commands, never as physical feedback.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure ThermoPilot
reconfigure.description: Update modes, sensors and hardware entities. The command strategy and thermostat identity remain unchanged.

error.select_at_least_one_mode: Select at least one thermal mode.
error.temperature_required: Select at least one temperature sensor.
error.humidity_required_for_dry: Dry mode requires at least one humidity sensor.
error.dry_command_required: Dry mode requires a command entity.
error.mode_command_required: Every enabled thermal mode requires a command entity.

abort.already_configured: A thermostat with this name is already configured.

init.title: Advanced ThermoPilot settings
init.description: Defaults are recommended for most installations. Change only values that have been validated for the connected equipment.

data.restore_off_on_delay: Restore delay between OFF and ON
data.power_off_below: Power below which the device is off
data.power_on_above: Power above which the device is on

error.invalid_temperature_range: Minimum target temperature must be lower than maximum.
error.invalid_sensor_range: Every minimum sensor value must be lower than its maximum.
error.invalid_dry_range: Dry OFF humidity must be lower than Dry ON humidity.
error.invalid_power_range: Power OFF threshold must be lower than the ON threshold.
